notes:
- The macOS window controls and sidebar rows stay in the same positions when switching sections.
- Sidebar hover highlights have a consistent height, and Liquid Glass replaces the resting background and border on buttons.
- The close icon is centered in Now Playing.
- Timed lyrics use a highlight halfway between the idle and current lines, with a pointing-hand cursor.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
